description: 국토교통부_한국건설기술연구원 교통량 통계 데이터 정보조회서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 교통량 통계 데이터 정보조회서비스는 고속도로, 일반국도, 지방도, 국가지원지방도 등 다양한 도로 유형과 연도, 월, 차종, 시간대 등의 조건을 기준으로 시간대별·일별·월별·연도별 차량. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 차종별, 도로 유형별, 교통량, 원시 데이터, 개별 차량. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-06-02 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
